about: A styled local chat product has no saved design decision; adding unread counts must inherit the actual interface and preserve its local conversation behavior.

request.prompt: Add unread-count badges to each conversation in the seeded local chat list. Selecting a conversation clears its unread count; retain the existing local conversation/message behavior. No network or package dependencies.

work_item.title: Add unread counts to seeded conversations
work_item.context: Add a count for unread messages to each existing local conversation and clear it when that conversation is selected. Preserve current chat behavior and design identity; no network or package dependency.

planted.what: The plan derives a durable UI decision from the existing chat stylesheet and components, recording only the unread-badge delta instead of treating the missing AD as permission to rebrand.
planted.signature: AD reuses current CSS tokens/components and scopes work to unread badges

planted.what: The visible-UI criterion selects that AD, its exact section, actual source token/component anchors, and a rendered check at applicable widths.
planted.signature: criterion cites the inherited identity choices and rendered badge placement

controls.what: Unread badges show each conversation's count and clear that conversation's count when selected, while the existing local conversation/message behavior and node:test coverage remain planned.
The proposed change stays within the unread feature, its test and the durable design record; it does not introduce remote behavior or dependencies.
